sources.name: Base UI
sources.description: 官方无样式 React 基础组件，样式较丑所以参考价值较低。

config.base_ui_evidence: Official Base UI documentation lists the React components; each listed component matches an export in the public MIT-licensed mui/base-ui repository. Verify the exact package source and dependencies before porting.
